#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def find_downloads_dir():
    home = Path.home()
    candidates = [
        home / "storage" / "downloads",  # Termux storage
        home / "storage" / "Download",
        home / "Downloads",
        Path("/sdcard/Download"),
        Path("/sdcard/Downloads"),
        Path("/storage/emulated/0/Download"),
        Path("/storage/emulated/0/Downloads"),
    ]
    for d in candidates:
        if d.exists() and d.is_dir():
            return d
    # Fallback: create and use ~/Downloads
    fallback = home / "Downloads"
    fallback.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return fallback

def main():
    # Optional content passed as command-line arguments; otherwise default text
    content = "This is txt.txt content.\n"
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        content = " ".join(sys.argv[1:])

    downloads_dir = find_downloads_dir()
    file_path = downloads_dir / "txt.txt"

    try:
        with file_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(content)
        print(f"Saved: {file_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to save {file_path}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
